title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Exchange Planner Work Item
summary: Add a deterministic local RFC 9464 Configuration Payload exchange planner above the existing encrypted DNS provisioning codecs and policies.
planned_changes:
- Add a value model for RFC 9464 ENCDNS_IP* and ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attributes carried inside a Configuration Payload.
- Add a planner for CFG_REQUEST support advertisements, CFG_REPLY response selection, and client resolver plan creation.
- Validate payload-type mismatches and non-request reply planning before future IKEv2 adapters can consume the model.
- Cover normal request/reply/client planning, mismatched payload rejection, non-request reply rejection, and responder-discard empty replies.
- Update the encrypted DNS gap ledger to distinguish local exchange planning from live IKEv2/platform integration.
verification_plan: Run the DNS package build, focused exchange planner tests, core SpecTrace validation, generated QUIC triage, and diff hygiene before commit.
out_of_scope: Live IKEv2 message parsing or transport.
completion_notes: The local exchange planner now composes RFC 9464 support advertisements, response selection, and client resolver planning while leaving live IKEv2 and platform integration as explicit future adapter work.
